exact_delta: Report retained contracts, implementation slices and acceptance gates as separate counts. Exclude explicitly identified umbrella/factory/advisory/policy records from a delivery-contract denominator while retaining their obligations. Preserve UNKNOWN when a bounded audit has no current whole-contract proof; absence of a reconciled receipt is not proof that a feature is missing. A merged source prerequisite establishes partial implementation even when the whole-issue projection remains unknown. Keep closure-ready narrow contracts and release verification/integration gates separate from features still requiring code.
